title: Out-of-Network Glasses Claims on the Vision Plans: 365-Day Filing Limit and Coverage Started by the Binder
content:
For a member's out-of-network claim on the Vision Plans that is settled on its glasses part, reimbursement is decided in the following order. The first case that holds governs.

**(i) Filed too late.** When the claim reached Cascade more than 365 calendar days after the date of service, nothing on the claim is reimbursed and its lines are denied for timely filing. A claim received on the 365th day after the date of service is in time; one received on the 366th is not.

**(ii) Binder received for an applied enrollment.** Otherwise, the enrollment may still stand applied while the latest binder payment the funding billing account received meets three conditions: it was not returned, it is for at least the plan unit's monthly premium for its coverage tier, and it was received on or before the binder deadline. The latest binder payment is the account's latest payment with payment purpose binder, in the Premium Billing Accounts records; it counts as returned when a returned-payment entry names it. The binder deadline is the coverage effective date plus 30 calendar days, and a payment on the deadline day is in time. In that case a service dated on or after the coverage effective date is reimbursed, coverage having started retroactively on that date.

**(iii) Otherwise.** The enrollment's own status and dates decide. The claim is reimbursed only when the enrollment is active or terminated and the date of service is on or after its coverage effective date and on or before its termination date when it has one. Otherwise its lines are denied as not eligible and nothing is reimbursed.

| Binder test | Met | Not met |
|---|---|---|
| Received, counted from the coverage effective date | Day 30 or earlier | Day 31 or later |
| Amount against the unit's monthly premium for its tier | Equal or higher | Lower |
| Returned | No returned-payment entry names it | A returned-payment entry names it |

*Hypothetical case.* An applied enrollment effective 1 June; the account's latest binder, unreturned and for the full monthly premium of the unit's tier, was received 25 June; the member's out-of-network exam and glasses are dated 12 June and filed within 365 days. They are reimbursed under the claim's amounts.
